about: Requests the old Bot Browser screen sent, recorded black-box against the live sites on 2026-11-18 (old screen at c724819731). Each step lists the screen state after a user action and the bot_browser_get/bot_browser_post calls it caused (picture fetches left out). Steps are cumulative. Query parameter order doesn't matter. A step with no requests sent nothing (for example Next disabled on the last page). CharacterTavern's site rejected every search that day, and JannyAI's detail page failed, so those providers have no detail step. DataCat resolved "fantasy" to tag id 6 from its tag list that day; "zzqx" was not a DataCat tag, so it was left out (decision 8 adds a notice, the request stays the same). JannyAI mapped "fantasy" to id 53 and fetched up to 3 extra pages for the made-up "zzqx".
